# Working days calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/working-days/

Count weekdays between dates or add a number of business days while skipping Saturday and Sunday. Optionally exclude a list of holidays.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Estimate a five-business-day deadline while excluding a known public holiday.

## Limits and checks

The default weekend is Saturday and Sunday. This is not an official Nepal working-calendar calculator; enter holidays manually.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
